text.p: Astrocom Corp said Thursday it was investigating possible accounting irregularities in its financial statements for the quarter ended March 31.

It said a former vice president-finance told management yesterday that he believes Astrocom's cash position at March 31 was overstated by about $240,000, and inventory and fixed assets were understated by a similar amount.
Astrocom said it is presently unable to verify the accuracy of these statements.
The company said the vice president-finance resigned his post effective April 25 and stepped down from all positions with the company on May 20.

Astrocom, which makes electronic devices, said a special committee of outside directors had been formed to oversee an investigation of accounting practices. The committee has asked Astrocom's independent auditors to assist them.
